ALOFT.gloss: at or on or to the masthead or upper rigging of a ship
ALOFT.definition: At or on or to the masthead or upper rigging of a ship.
ALOFT.example: Climbed aloft to unfurl the sail.

FLOAT.gloss: be in motion due to some air or water current
FLOAT.definition: Be in motion due to some air or water current.
FLOAT.example: The leaves were blowing in the wind.

FLAT.gloss: having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another
FLAT.definition: Having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another.

LOFT.gloss: floor consisting of a large unpartitioned space over a factory or warehouse or other…
LOFT.definition: Floor consisting of a large unpartitioned space over a factory or warehouse or other commercial space.

LOAF.gloss: a shaped mass of baked bread that is usually sliced before eating
LOAF.definition: A shaped mass of baked bread that is usually sliced before eating.

ALTO.gloss: a singer whose voice lies in the alto clef
ALTO.definition: A singer whose voice lies in the alto clef.

LOT.gloss: a large number or amount or extent
LOT.definition: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent.

FAT.gloss: a soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids
FAT.definition: A soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids (mostly triglycerides).
